steps.instruction: Read the challenged rule, exact pre-repair manifest, originating surface/reference and concrete evidence. Confirm applicability and identify one canonical owner before writing. Ask for missing evidence; reject a request that belongs to a consumer fix.

reads.when: for each evidence or manifest file

calls.purpose: Read the exact challenged authority, manifest and concrete evidence.

produces: A validated challenge and canonical owner.

steps.instruction: Answer the maintenance questions in order: enforce an existing rule first, add a concept only when it has no home, correct a too-narrow rule in place, and fold duplicate homes. Edit only the canonical authority and directly required mirror while preserving stable identifiers and thresholds.

writes.when: when the knowledge set requires a language mirror

calls.purpose: Apply the smallest canonical evidence-backed repair.

steps.instruction: Rebuild the exact manifest, compare all stable ids and changed concepts, and inspect the diff for duplicated authority or unrelated edits. Write the repair report with evidence links and an explicit fresh-rerun binding; repair only the failed owner detail and reassess.

calls.purpose: Run only the declared manifest and knowledge validation commands.
Persist manifest, report and targeted repair metadata.

steps.instruction: Create one local knowledge commit, re-read its tree and validate the response. Return done only after all criteria pass; the response directs the originating operation to rerun on the same surface and makes no acceptance claim.

calls.purpose: Commit the exact canonical owner repair once.
Validate the compiled request and response.
